sentence: From 2022-02-24 to 2026-11-25 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +43.4% a year (worst drawdown -35.9%) against +38.4% (-41.3%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 88% of stock-weeks.
